title: SurgicGuide Announces HK$120 Million Series B Financing
html:
SurgicGuide Limited is pleased to announce the successful completion of a HK$120 million Series B financing round, marking an important milestone in the company’s continued growth.

The financing will support the development and clinical translation of SurgicGuide’s FLIM and AI-based surgical imaging platform, designed to provide surgeons with real-time guidance during tumour resection.

The new funding will accelerate clinical validation, AI and imaging technology development, regulatory preparation, and product engineering, while supporting the expansion of SurgicGuide’s collaborations with leading academic and clinical institutions.

“We are grateful to our investors and partners for their continued confidence in our vision,” said Sum, Tsz-tak, Chief Executive Officer of SurgicGuide Limited. “This investment will allow us to accelerate our development programmes and bring our technology closer to clinical application.”
